attempts.sql:
WITH connector_classes AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id, s.qualname, s.file_id
  FROM code.symbols s
  JOIN code.class_bases b ON s.symbol_id = b.class_symbol_id
  WHERE b.base_name = 'SQLDatabase'
    AND s.file_id NOT IN (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE is_test = TRUE)
    AND s.kind = 'class'
),
connector_methods AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id, s.name AS method_name, s.file_id
  FROM code.symbols s
  WHERE s.kind = 'method'
    AND s.file_id IN (SELECT class_symbol_id FROM connector_classes)
    AND s.name NOT LIKE '_%'
),
connector_method_owners AS (
  SELECT cm.symbol_id AS method_owner, cm.method_name
  FROM connector_methods cm
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.class_bases cb
    WHERE cb.class_symbol_id = cm.symbol_id
      AND cb.base_name != 'SQLDatabase'
  )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM code.symbols parent
      WHERE parent.symbol_id = (
        SELECT cb.class_symbol_id
        FROM code.class_bases cb2
        WHERE cb2.base_symbol_id = parent.symbol_id
          AND cb2.base_name != 'SQLDatabase'
      )
        AND cm.method_name = parent.name
        AND parent.kind = 'class'
        AND parent.file_id = cm.file_id
        AND parent.line_start < cm.line_start
        AND parent.line_end > cm.line_end
    )
)
SELECT c.class_symbol_id, cm.method_name
FROM connector_method_owners cm
JOIN connector_classes c ON cm.method_owner = c.class_symbol_id
ORDER BY c.class_symbol_id, cm.method_name;

request:
The production database connectors are the classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (defined in auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding any class defined in test code (every file under a tests/ folder counts as test code). For each such connector class, which public methods does the class define in its own body that SQLDatabase itself does not define? A method is public when its name does not start with an underscore (so __init__ and other dunder methods are excluded); anything written with def directly in the class body counts as a method, including properties and context-manager methods. Methods inherited without being redefined do not count. Return one row per (connector class symbol ID, method name).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), method_name (string).
explanation: The corrected query removes the invalid self-reference to alias 'cb' in the first NOT EXISTS clause and replaces it with a direct check against code.class_bases. The second NOT EXISTS now correctly identifies parent classes by matching method names against class symbols in the same file that enclose the method's line range, excluding inherited methods.
